title: RUC error 33: compressor start failure
summary: Error 33 means the compressor failed to start. The most common cause is low DC voltage under load; other causes include the control unit or AC-DC adaptor, poor connections, unusually high system pressure, or rarely the compressor.
steps: Measure the DC supply while the compressor is attempting to start.
Check cable size and connections at the battery, fuse block and terminal block.
If supply remains adequate, test the AC-DC adaptor output and controller connections using the source procedure.
warnings: Electrical diagnosis should be performed by a suitably qualified technician. Isolate power before disconnecting wiring.

title: Portable fridge three flashes: compressor start failure

steps: Measure supply voltage at the fridge while the compressor attempts to start.
Check cable size, leads, battery condition and loose connections.
If voltage is stable, inspect controller and compressor connections before replacing parts.
warnings: Disconnect power before checking controller or compressor connections. Winding tests should be completed by a qualified technician.
